package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for scan_into_map_string_any_hot_path: Rows scanned into map[string]any instead of typed structs on hot paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

func scenario296Positive(db *gorm.DB) ([]map[string]any, error) {
	rows, err := db.Raw("SELECT id, name, email, status FROM users WHERE active = ?", true).Rows()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var results []map[string]any
	for rows.Next() {
		var row map[string]any
		if err := db.ScanRows(rows, &row).Error; err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		results = append(results, row)
	}
	return results, nil
}
